And don’t get me started on the repetitious invasive ask that I write a review - well you got what you asked for Pixelup.  Here’s the review you harassed me for - I hope you are happy.  All for way too much money.  Stay away.

reviews.title: Sucks
reviews.text: this app sucks. I immediately deleted it after it forced me to watch 2 long as heck ads and another one that was impossible to click out of and I had to sit there trying to click out of it and it tried to click me to the App Store and back out of the app a bunch of times and had no way to x out of it and I had to close the whole app out and reopen the app, which caused me to have to completely restart my photo editing from the beginning just to get out of the ad which then caused me to have to watch TWO MORE ads just to restart. I tried to restore a wallpaper photo and it didn’t do a good job either. I could barely see a difference and it was still grainy. Then I had to watch another stupid ad just to try to edit the stuff myself cause the app completely failed at restoring it. Greed of companies is unfortunate.
